summary: Project finalization confirmation modal, RPC loading state, success state, and dashboard handoff verified. Clicking 'Continue to finalize' opens .ob-exec-modal displaying accurate counts of Prompts (4), Personas (2), Keywords (2), and Persona prompt bindings (0). Confirming displays the loading state ('Oluşturuluyor…', disabled button). Upon finalization resolution (fz.phase === 'done'), modal updates to 'Your project is ready' ('Projeniz hazır') and 'Go to dashboard' ('Panele git') cleanly transitions the user to the active app route.
